slides.title: Welcome!
dialogue: Hey! I'm **Beaker** — official ChatGPT Lab mascot and _self-appointed_ event planner.
I heard you're going to host a ChatGPT Lab on your campus. Congrats — that's literally my favorite thing.
I'll walk you through planning it step by step. We'll keep it simple, and you can come back anytime — we save your progress.

slides.title: What's a ChatGPT Lab?
dialogue: A ChatGPT Lab is a **one-hour, peer-led, show-and-tell** event where students share how they're using AI.
The goal isn't to 'teach' everyone AI. It's to explore with curiosity and leave with an **'I wonder if…'** and the confidence to try something new.

slides.title: What do I get as a host?
dialogue: You'll get support and resources to run a great event.
Typically, OpenAI provides things like **100 Chats books** to help start the conversation.
And you'll be part of the host community — basically a **campus ambassador** for bringing the Lab to your school.
Your event can also get highlighted back to the broader Lab community.

slides.title: Here's the plan
dialogue: We'll do this in three parts:
1) **Conceptual planning** — decide what kind of Lab you're running.
2) **Logistical planning** — lock in the details so you can actually host it.
3) **Summary** — we'll generate a clean planning doc and a ChatGPT link so you can keep working on it.
Ready? Let's make a Lab worth showing up to.
